highlights.title: Systems thinking
highlights.desc: I look beyond individual features to understand how the pieces fit together. From data models to application architecture, I enjoy designing systems that are understandable, adaptable, and built to last.

highlights.title: End-to-end development
highlights.desc: With over a decade of Rails experience and growing expertise in native iOS development, I’m comfortable working across the stack. I enjoy everything from backend architecture and APIs to the interactions that make an application feel right.

highlights.title: Thoughtful execution
highlights.desc: Good ideas deserve careful implementation. I value clear requirements, maintainable code, meaningful tests, and continuous refinement. My goal is always to build something that works well today without making tomorrow harder.
